verdict.rationale: dltHub's AI Harness provides skills, rules and MCP servers that teach Claude Code, Cursor or Codex to build production pipelines, with an example request like ingesting GitHub PRs and issues. The /context offering claims to make assistants expert dlt developers across 11,200+ REST API sources. Generated code targets the declarative rest_api source, which covers endpoints, relationships, pagination and authentication, and dlt-init-openapi generates pipelines from OpenAPI specs, which a contributor praised on Show HN. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence that AI-drafted connectors work out of the box, documented coverage of drafting from free-form (non-OpenAPI) documentation, and an explicit review-before-ship workflow.
